invariant_note: UpgradedAttentionCIRCombiner was trained with English modifiers (AGENTS.md F.2). Law 1 forbids retraining/modifying best_model.pt; all improvements are strictly at the inference layer.

tuning_dataset.diacritic_split_rule: Deterministic 50/50 split on locked cir_eval_val.json: even index (idx % 2 == 0, n=60) uses original modifier_vi (dia_class='full'); odd index (idx % 2 == 1, n=60) uses strip_diacritics(modifier_vi) (dia_class='none'). Also report full 120-pair all_full and all_none diagnostics.

test_dataset_policy.note: NEVER run eval/cir_eval_test.json or index/test_gallery/ in Prompt 13.

candidates_description.C1: Translate Vietnamese modifier -> English modifier using fashion-domain attribute table generated from data/catalog/catalog_rebuild.parquet (baseColour, gender, articleType + modifier connectors); unknown tokens kept as-is.
candidates_description.C2: Text-only fusion: score = beta * cos(combiner, img) + (1 - beta) * cos(text_query_attr, img), with pre-defined small grid beta in {0.85, 0.70}.
candidates_description.C3: Attribute bonus (tier_soft, gamma=1.0) from parser_v2.1 on the modifier part only (colour/gender change), without gating uncertain slots.
candidates_description.C4: (Optional) Light PRF Rocchio (k=3, rocchio_beta=0.15) on combiner vector; only kept if Delta mAP 95% cluster bootstrap CI excludes 0 and latency constraint 5(iv) passes.

selection_and_tie_breaking_rule: Select config maximizing mAP on CIR-eval val (120 pairs, 50/50 full/none split) subject to p95 < 200 ms on both CIR catalog and CIR upload. C4 (PRF Rocchio) is only kept if its Delta mAP vs the corresponding non-C4 config has a 95% paired cluster bootstrap CI (1000 resamples) strictly above 0. Among configs whose mAP difference vs the top config has a 95% paired cluster bootstrap CI containing 0, choose the simpler config by simplicity_order.
